summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an ordinary share buyback on 21 April 2026, purchasing 335,000 shares via BNP Paribas at a VWAP of 2,103.08 GBp (range 2,074–2,130 GBp). Shares are held as treasury; the buyback is part of a programme announced 17 February 2026. Since programme launch, 20,521,521 shares have been repurchased. The filing details individual trades on XLON, CHIX, and BATE venues. This is a routine capital return activity, not a special situation event. No regulatory or structural complexities; continued execution under existing authority is the key monitorable.
